title: T-2979: Park period vehicles and complete vehicle/horse research
body:
Park three refined 1835 farm wagons and two curved-canvas covered wagons at their existing yard stands, plus an empty 1904 carriage on Prairie Avenue. The covered wagons retain their distinct blue/oxide and oak/dark-oak finishes, aging seeds, bearings and laid-by yokes. Maker and ownership remain unknown; the existing carriage remains a reconstructed generic type.

![Western Hotel covered wagon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-tickets/main/evidence/parked-vehicles-2026-10-22/checkpoint-combined-vehicle-preflight/source-desktop-western-front-quarter-refined.png)

![Wolf Point covered wagon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-tickets/main/evidence/parked-vehicles-2026-10-22/checkpoint-combined-vehicle-preflight/source-desktop-wolfpoint-front-quarter-refined.png)

The source repair makes the original reviewed wagon products reproducible across Python versions and tested CPU paths. Explicit floating sums preserve the original hardware/parts; the default material producer now reads validated original authored Float32 charts rather than resolving ambiguous PCA axes again. Both controlled backends produce the original intermediate material GLB, and the full W01 and covered-wagon wrappers reproduce every reviewed output byte. All original input, geometry, ownership, recipe and final-product guards remain. The explicit numerical-authoring path remains available; there is no missing-chart fallback or cached whole-model input.

T-2792 and T-2799 deliver their completed vehicle/horse reference registers and executable master specifications. The records distinguish Kinzie's 1831 Dearborn wagon, the cleared 1893 Studebaker Brougham construction reference, observed period harness and declared modern anatomy analogies. No Pullman ownership or earlier eligibility is invented. Photograph access failures, incomplete viewer coverage and modeling limits remain explicit. These research changes do not make the parked generic carriage a named manufacturer model. The corrected Kinzie citation also regenerates its existing resident-research CSV/XLSX; resident identities and adjudications are unchanged.

The complete 404-source index needs 161,435 raw bytes, so its declared allowance moves from 160,000 to 168,000 under the standing measured-headroom policy. Actual index/module/CSS gzip is 45,965 bytes against the unchanged 120,000-byte first-open limit. Full citations remain intact. Separately, Full detail with active Ghost views uses the previously measured 8,900-draw/3,675,000-triangle envelope; ordinary views, Balanced and Light retain their limits. Parent/current controlled Normal/X-ray/Ghost counts were 3,694/8,222/8,465 versus 3,695/8,223/8,466; rendering work is unchanged apart from one shadow-yard draw.

Validation at `ca82d06541b31a560d0c29e426668e777db3ad61`: full CI-matching Python3.11 preflight PASS,1,041 checks including380 deliberate refusal self-tests; exact own-commit/PR-diff changelog and ID checks PASS. The first research-integrated preflight passed 1,040/1,041 checks and caught the stale Kinzie-derived research export; its failure is retained, and the ordinary exporter repaired it. Twelve authored-chart input refusals and the existing eight covered-wagon controls pass. Independent review verified all 46 original Float32 chart streams, 158 mapping rows, source/license hashes and citation-only workbook changes. Post-commit publication/mirror and targeted Sources-panel checks: post-commit publisher/mirror PASS (2,032 exact,3,117 declared transforms,zero unmapped); actual Sources acceptance PASS on390mobile and1280desktop,404rows,161435raw/45965gzip bytes,no page errors,and forcedHTTP503recovery. The original tool stopped on an obsolete retry-only entry selector; that failure is preserved. The reviewed external V2 uses the current ordinary Free Roam entry, with every original catalog/navigation/recovery/budget assertion unchanged and exact source/index/mirror guards. This is explicitly a modified inspection caller, not an unchanged standard-tool pass.

All 18 original published-scene smoke jobs at e694849a2c516a9862a2564c5ff86d97406e09ab now have strictly bound successful actual jobs/logs, including all mobile cells. They remain historical e694 jobs. The exact renderer/scene/model projection is unchanged by the authoring repair except provenance-only sidecar fields. The new source-catalog records, derived catalog and release-note metadata are explicit differences covered separately; no assertion that all data is unchanged. The original normal CI failure and later dd147 material failure/Light TURN spike remain preserved. Current-head normal CI and ordinary merge guards: sourcegate39719291796 PASS all1041steps and changelog on exact synthetic merge9a581978a78c36db87f8355660ebf8dc1c75a690 (DEVfdb227db +ca82); report39719285501 PASS with actualca82checkout; moving-frames39719291472 stillrunning. Merge remains held until the remaining actual check is green. No all-green or DEV merge claim before those pass.

[Saved evidence and handover](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-tickets/tree/main/evidence/parked-vehicles-2026-10-22). This consolidates source work from closed, unmerged draft #1176. T-2979/T-2981 cover the initial parked increment and its measured runtime envelope. T-2980 remains open for full photographic and compressed-LOD acceptance. T-2794 model production, photographic people/horses, occupied fit, animation, traffic, boarding and riding remain open. DEV only; no production promotion.
